# Build a valid llms.txt for your site

> Paste your site's page list, a sitemap.xml, or a Markdown docs tree and get a valid llms.txt file — the emerging llmstxt.org convention that gives AI assistants a structured map of your site. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded. Validate an existing llms.txt too.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
